Privacy notice

How we handle your information.

This notice covers the Rerol Refinery website and enquiries started through it. Updated 04 November 2026.

Contact Rerol ↗ Call sales

Who to contact

Rerol Refinery Private Limited operates this website. Contact us at rerolrefinery@gmail.com, +91 91766 42399, or 106, Santhome High Road, Chennai 600028.

Information you choose to share

Enquiry forms ask for your name, phone number and requirement. Depending on the form, you can also provide your company, email, monthly quantity, delivery or pickup location and a message. Please share only information needed to discuss your requirement.

How enquiries work

The website prepares a WhatsApp message from the details you enter. Continuing opens WhatsApp with that draft; you decide whether to send it. The form does not email the enquiry or store it in a website database. WhatsApp processes information under its own privacy policy when you use its service.

We use information you send to respond, discuss products and specifications, prepare quotations and coordinate requested services. Information needed for an ongoing enquiry, transaction or applicable record-keeping requirement may be retained for that purpose.

Hosting and external services

Vercel hosts this website and may process technical request information such as IP address, request time, browser details and the page requested to deliver and secure the service. Google Fonts supplies website fonts. Links to WhatsApp, Maps and reference websites lead to services with their own privacy practices.

Optional analytics and cookies

Google Analytics loads only after you choose “Allow analytics.” It measures page visits and general interactions such as selecting a call or WhatsApp link. Our analytics code does not send form field values, phone numbers, messages or URL query strings. Google Analytics may use cookies and process technical and usage information when enabled.

Choosing “Essential only” keeps analytics off. A preference is saved in your browser so the website can remember your choice. You can change it with the Analytics preferences link in the footer or .

Your enquiries and preferences

Contact Rerol to ask about information you have shared, request a correction or deletion, or ask us to stop contacting you. Include enough detail to identify your enquiry. Some information may need to be retained for an ongoing transaction or applicable obligations.

Changes to this notice

Changes will appear on this page with an updated date. For details about external providers, see Vercel’s privacy policy, Google’s privacy policy and WhatsApp’s privacy policy.
